answer: Every new identity reports to a rotating intake harbor and posts a bond equal to one epoch of median mining reward. A lottery assigns two established interviewers who each pose a unique question about a recent ledger artifact. Their sealed scores must match within one point before a thin ember of spendable reputation lights; a later near-copy slashes that ember and the bond for every matching identity. The applicant must then finish one useful grade inside a randomly chosen meadow of peers whose co-signature graphs miss the applicant's invite tree, so clones cannot huddle together.
